findings.text: §9's done-when claims "§2's landed tests pass unchanged", but §9's own mechanism ("prints the detail in place of the from and to state words", with the done-when requiring "no `new → working`") deletes the state cell that §2's landed test asserts: `tests/test_a_limit_reset_reaches_every_pane.py:170` requires `"working" in rendered` (beside `ticker.LIMIT_STAGE in rendered` at :169), and the row the renderer builds today reads `new → working` because `PANE_STATES` maps the `limit-reset` state to `ticker.py`'s `working` word. Remove the from/to cells and no "working" reaches the rendered string, so that assertion fails at head — the superseded row and the "pass unchanged" clause are the same test, and §9 names it only obliquely in its write paths ("the tests asserting the superseded row, named from the failure ids")
